name: best-practices
title_zh: 一键给代码做安全与质量体检并现代化改造
tagline_zh: 当你说“检查漏洞”或“现代化代码”，它直接动手：查安全、查兼容、查坏味道，并给出可落地的修复建议。
tagline_en: Say 'security audit' or 'modernize code' and it acts: checks security, compatibility, and quality, then gives.
desc_en: Apply modern web development best practices for security, compatibility, and code quality. Use when asked to "apply best practices", "security audit", "modernize code", "code quality review", or "check for vulnerabilities".
why_zh: 它把分散的 Web 最佳实践编译成可执行的检查清单，按需触发，自动定位问题并给出具体改法。
why_en: It compiles scattered web best practices into an executable checklist, triggered on demand, pinpointing issues with concrete.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Web 前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS），不处理后端或框架特有逻辑；依赖静态分析，无法检测运行时漏洞。
limit_en: Web front-end only (HTML/CSS/JS); no backend or framework-specific logic; static analysis only, no runtime vulns; suggestions need human review, no.
